name: services/surveys/surveys_to_fill2
description: Get the list of surveys waiting to be filled out by the user.
brief_description: Get the list of surveys waiting to be filled out by the user.

arguments.name: include_filled_out
arguments.description:
Boolean. "true" if already filled out surveys should be
                included in results

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of survey2 method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: List of survey objects, as defined in the survey2 method.
